label: High-Precision Watchmaker Tweezers
description: Ultra-fine, anti-magnetic stainless steel tweezers designed for manipulating micro-fossils under a microscope.

components.function: Allows for the gripping of fossils smaller than 0.5mm.
Ensures the player doesn't apply too much 'crush force' to a fragile specimen.
Matte finish to prevent LED ring-light reflections from blinding the preparator.

game_mechanics.tremor_simulation: Higher magnification levels increase the visual 'jitter' of the tweezers, requiring the player to time their 'click' to pick up a fossil.
game_mechanics.the_ping_effect: If the player releases the tension too quickly, the fossil can 'ping' (shoot out of the tweezers) and get lost in the lab, requiring a search mini-game.
